title: Finite Čech totalization preserves coefficient homotopies
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $r\geq0$ and $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X_{\mathrm{open}}$ any family, without a covering assumption. For integer-indexed complexes $K,L$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and cochain maps $f,g:K\to L$, a cochain homotopy $h:f\sim g$ induces a cochain homotopy $T_U(f)\sim T_U(g)$ for the actual total functor of [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex].

source.place: Tag 08C1, proof: functoriality verification; parent Step 3, signed total homotopy calculation

proof.text: The Lean proof first proves the generic assertion for an additive functor A from a preadditive category to integer cochain complexes. On the (p,q) summand define H using p.negOnePow times the p component of A(h from q to q-1), followed by the target total summand inclusion. Assemble by totalDesc. Off degree m=n-1 the summand inclusion is zero by p+(q-1) != m.

Check the homotopy equation after each total inclusion, using total.hom_ext. Expand both total differentials into D1 and D2. The horizontal terms cancel by naturality of A(h) and negOnePow_succ. The vertical sign squares to one by Int.units_mul_self. Apply A to the original coefficient homotopy equation, use its additivity and functoriality, and conclude by additive-group normalization. Specialize A to alternatingCechModuleFunctor U. This proof is fully closed in Lean, including negative indices and the empty family.

theorem alternatingCechTotal_map_homotopy
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens)
    {K L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ}
    {f g : K ⟶ L} (h : Homotopy f g) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy ((alternatingCechTotalFunctor U).map f)
      ((alternatingCechTotalFunctor U).map g))
